reviews.review_description: Quoting honest  and reasonably pricedInstallation efficientCommunication at every stage transparent

Future Friendly quotation was both fair and reasonable with no hidden surprises.  On time, on budget and a very neat and professional installation by Brian.  A company that I would have no hesitation in recommending to anybody in the Geelong region.Being on an embedded supply system it was frustrating that I had to use mandated third-party companies to (a) complete the monitoring system,and (b) a one-star rated Victorian communication company who between them manufactured excuses, delays and inefficiencies to take more than five weeks for my solar system to become operational.  Simon (Future Friendly) going "above and beyond" in trying to progress the third party completion of the system.

The quoting process was so easy with expert knowledge and friendliness.The installers were polite neat and so organised.Great to see a local team with a can do attitude to do my little old house.So happy with the finished job.Well done team.?
Have who hesitation in recommending Future Friendly to do the install. Excellent communication and very competitive quotes. Thanks Simon, Guy and team.
The guys made the whole process so quick and easy. Friendly, professional and knowledgable.
Guy made the whole process easy including applying for rebates and the government loan. His inverter snd panels are top rated products.
Completely professional and efficient. Great team, especially Brian! Would recommend them to anyone seeking solar installation. Paperwork was completed with ease-thank you Simon.

From quoting to installation, I have been impressed with the knowledge, problem solving and personalisation of the approach offered by the team. Excellent communication, workmanship and products for a highly competitive price
Clear quotation and information.Friendly staff, quick install and all was cleaned up.Great customer service, all paperwork taken care of.

Future Friendly Solar were great. They were super helpfull throughout the process. The government rebate was tricky at best and the team at FFS were there to help at every turn. As far as the actual install and units go... Exemplary! We are stoked and could not be happier about Guy and his team at Future Friendly Solar! Thanks!
We were very impressed with the service given and with communication follow up with any questions we had.Very good people to deal with  and the installers were very neat and efficient.

We were very impressed with the quoting and advice provided and then installation carried out by the team from Future Friendly. Great customer service, high quality installation and professional service. The installation went extremely well and we were consulted on all issues by the team. Highly recommended.
Super friendly and knowledgeable team and happy to help with follow up questions.No issues what so ever.

Everything that the company promised to do, they did and their equipment does.  The solar power we derive from our system has more than halved our electricity bills in our pharmacy which is open every day of the week 9-8pm.The system cost us approx $10000, and we are saving around $250 per month, thus this system will pay itself off in just over three years ASSUMING no further increases in power cost (unlikely).  I think this is a worthwhile return on investment, considering the environment benefits at the same time.The installation was seamless.  The installers professional and courteous AND THOUGHTFUL.I am just about to roll out solar onto a number of other properties we own.
Value for money and Quality of system we will need to wait and see.Having real trouble getting the Fronius monitoring app to work.....REAL TROUBLE.
Excellent service and response from Guy -no hesitation in recommending him.

I had a 5kw inverter with 2kw of solar panels and I wanted to add an extra 3kw of panels.Future Friendly Solar did the job promptly and entirely to my satisfaction. The fact that are an independant local company (Mornington) is an added bonus to me.
Did the job efficiently and in a clean manner, great communucation and would recommend his any time

The whole process from point of contact with Guy to completing the installation was efficient and competent and reaffirmed that our decision that to use 'futurefriendly solar power' was the right decision. Of course the system has not been installed for very long, but we have always been advocates of solar power having an off the grid/stand alone system at another house we own on the Great Ocean Road for 9 years.  We are sure our experience with this system will be beneficial and cannot stress enough the expertise demonstrated by Guy and Chris.
Good advice when selecting final choice. Installation on time, on budget and professional neat, efficient job. Good after service and follow up on queries.
Our supplier Guy Skewes from Future Friendly Solar Geelong was professional at all times. We have no hesitation in recommending Guy to any one looking for a Solar System.
Guy and his crew attended  to my installation in a timely and professional manner. They did exactly as they said they would, no messing around and no false promises.
Guy was friendly and courteous and completed the solar installation as promised , highly recommended.

Really good install with exception to the final stage when it needed to be configured to the tablet to monitor the output, I spent hours if not days trying to figure it out.Always seems to be in a hurry to be somewhere else.
Very thorough inspection of site and explanations before giving quote.  Came on the date agreed to and system was working same day.  Very pleasant and friendly staff.

We had several quotes done but we found that the easy no fuss style from Future Friendly staff a pleasure to deal with.Due to the size of the system it was installed over a few days. During this time we were kept informed as to progress and any issues they encountered and how they over come them.The installers were extremely fussy as to how the panels were aligned to each other even though the roof was a bit up and down in places. The finished result shows the panel alignment to be straight and uniform. Which looks pretty slick.Ladders had protectors so as to not scratch the guttering.Extra work and materials to mount the Inverter were done and not charged for.All rubbish was removed.Follow up questions have been answered promptly.

Guy was not the cheapest quote but certainly not the dearest. Came up with a very good solution for a difficult installation. A very neat job with quality components - Fronius inverter and Trinia panels. Very happy with result and would recommend to others.
Future Friendly were very thorough explaining our options and the process to complete installation. They've kept us well informed of progress to date on the paperwork for the grid connection.
We did extensive research and Future Friendly were the best Co. we found.
Very fast and efficient installation and turn around time was only two weeks.

My wife and I have found Future Friendly/Guy Skewes to be a very competent solar specialist.  Guy is a qualified electrician who has a very sound knowledge of the solar industry.  We found his knowledge and expertise most helpful when we were first tentatively feeling our way into our initial (residential) solar installation and then again when we decided to upgrade the system in preparation for battery installation.

Had a friend recommend Future Friendly to me after he had Guy and his team install a larger system at his house.We had an older 1.5kW system that was not really doing much to offset our use, so spoke to Guy about our usage and what would be appropriate. Got very straight forward advice and pricing that I felt very comfortable going ahead with.Guy and his team did a great job removing the old system (which we managed to resell the panels from) and installing the new panels and inverter. Panels look great on the roof, which I was worried about at first - really helps when someone does a job this cleanly! Great quality Fronius inverter too with excellent connectivity to my phone.No hesitation in recommending Future Friendly to anyone looking for a quality system at a good price!

From first contact Guy Skewes provided the most professional service of any tradesperson that I have ever encountered. Site inspection done at agreed time. Quote provided very quickly. Price very good. Installation done at agreed time and very quickly. Not one bit of mess left behind. The most professional tradesperson that I have ever dealt with.

Received 3 credible quotes.  All proposed components in the quality / price range we wanted.Future Friendly got the nod on a combination of factors, including price, but also their promptness in coming onsite to discuss the installation.
Turned up on time. Great service and quality installation using high quality panels and inverter.
Helpful and honest person
Service was first rate. Installation very quick and efficient.

Our local Future Friendly Solar (Guy Skewes)  and his colleague were excellent in every way.   It was not an easy installation but we believe it could not have been done cleaner or more efficiently than they provided!  It was actually word of mouth that we contacted Guy as we had heard nothing but good reports about his work.   We are very happy to recommend Future Friendly to all who are investigating this option.
Very glad to see the solar power produced every day

I chose Future Friendly Australia based on my observation of our neighbour's installation by the same company and the fact that they have been in operation locally for several years, which gives me peace of mind if I ever have any post installation issues with the system. Before signing up all of my questions were simply answered in terms that I could easily understand. There was no hard sell. I was very impressed with FFA's professionalism, efficiency and workmanship. The job was completed in less than a day and the finished job looked very neat and tidy.A big thank you to Guy and the team at Future Friendly Australia

Very professional quote and installation, Guy ( the owner) was prepared to visit our home and give advice and information, he was approachable and pleasant. The installation was done in a day, very neatly with minimum fuss and Guy was prepared to sort out some extra electrical problems as well.

Guy provided a no nonsense approach that was honest and timely. The installation was swift and very tidy, a pleasure to have on the  property. I would recommend Future Friendly to any one considering solar, in fact have done so already. I now look forward to the benefits.

Incredibly efficient right across the board. Great communication. Fast turnover time from first conversation to installation. 5 stars the whole way. The guy that sell you the system,installs the system no bull you get exactly what you want.

Excellent service, advice and follow up by Guy and his team.  They arrived at the agreed time for first meeting, quote was prompt, queries were dealt with in detail and the installation was done as planned - highly recommended.

Our Future Friendly Solar has been working for a year now!The results are as follows:Before Solar was installed for the 2015 Year we used 13647 kWh - $3186.00After Solar was installed over the 2016 Year we used 6608 kWh - $1460.00A 120% saving, I'm obviously very pleased with the results!I'm using most of the Solar power and returning minimal to the grid.We have a pool with pumps running throughout the year, I did not realise how much electricity they were using.We are running 15 panels and our solar supply did not drop markedly throughout winter, we live in Melbourne!

We were very happy with the service that Guy at Futurefriendly gave us. From the moment he came to our home to give us a quote, explaining the best system to suit our needs, to the installation and follow up service. Guy made the whole process very easy for us and he is a very helpful, professional and friendly person to deal with. We would recommend him without any hesitation.
Guy and his team were great. Great customer service and excellent high quality system. I wouldn't want to deal with anyone else!!!

Guy was very capable and helpful with all aspects of the installation of my upgraded solar power systemThe boys did an excellent and efficient job with installation and the Admin side was prompt and very helpful.Certainly will get my recommendations.
I can highly recommend Guy Skewes and Future Friendly for any level of solar power installation.

I like to deal with a local company, so they ticked all the boxes as far as service, quality, honesty, price and being local are concerned. I would use them again if required and would certainly recommend them to other people.

I found Guy Skewes to be very professional. After reviewing our energy consumption, he was able to recommend a system that best suited our requirements. He was highly knowledgeable and set our minds at ease after addressing all of our concerns.Future Friendly arrived on the agreed morning and our new solar system was up and running that afternoon. We're extremely happy with the finished product and the savings we're noticing on our energy bills.I've recommended Future Friendly to all of my friends. Thanks Guy!
Guy and the team were fantastic with there work and knowledge of products.As a custom builder i will be happy to use future friendly solar on all my jobs
Explained everything extremely well about the system and after the job was done cleaned up the mess totally.
I can only have the highest praise for the quality, efficiency and value for money for the Solar Installation by Future Friendly.
This is the second time we have used our supplier and the great service continued.  We did not get any other quotes.
I am very impressed with Future Friendly and would certainly use them again.
Very efficient installation; no mess and no fuss and very helpful advice.  Well done, team
They were fantastic

When asking for quotes, I stipulated that I wanted a system that would work during winter that was capable of running my electric heater(s) off the solar for the maximum time. I was assured by all this was not a problem.Even though I  selected the largest system of the four quotes, it looks at the moment it will be maximum of 4 to 5 hours at the most I be getting any useful output.
Fantastic!
Very professional, friendly, courteous. I have absolutely nothing negative to say about  this company. I would recommend them to anybody.

I think I logged on to Solar Quotes twice and we went with one of the original quotes.One of the main reasons we went with the company we did was that the sales person was the electrician who was installing the system. He actually got on the roof with me to show me the layout of the system. He could answer every question I asked. He was not a salesman with the usual rote answers. I was supplied with full details of every component of the system so I could do my own research.The installing went like clock work. No delays. Early start, finished when they said. Inspectors here within the week. A professional, reliable job.
